Whole-property rental (September – June)

The price is for the whole complex for up to 29 people + 8 extra beds, including the saunas, relaxation room, hot tub (from March 2027) and covered terrace. Extra charges

  • Handover and check-out, standard cleaning and bed linen: added to the booking automatically
  • Electricity by actual consumption (including heating and EV charging), meter read on arrival and departure
  • Tourist tax per municipal rules
  • Extras (terrace kiosk, preparation day, outside catering, cot) are added directly in the booking
  • Dogs free when renting the whole property

Packages for weddings a parties, companies and holidays have their own prices in the booking.

On departure we deduct the electricity used (per meter reading) and any other charges from the deposit. The rest is returned to you on the spot.

Terms

  • The booking is confirmed once the 50% deposit is paid (due within 14 days) or once confirmed by the host.
  • Free cancellation more than 60 days before arrival; after that the deposit is forfeited.
  • Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 10:00.
  • Quiet hours: keep noise down after 22:00, complete silence from midnight.
  • Do not switch off the site equipment (filtration, water heating).
